content.title: Netflix Expected a ‘KPop’ Rally. Elon Musk and Tariffs Got In the Way
content.summary: The movie has been a huge hit, becoming Netflix’s most-watched original film.  The first-half gains would be reason enough for investors to think twice about buying Netflix shares.  Then President Donald Trump threatened to impose a 100% tariff “on any and all movies that are made outside of the United States,” and Elon Musk urged his social-media followers to cancel their subscriptions after taking issue with comments made by the creator of a now canceled Netflix show.
